description: This is a Java unit test file for the ImmutableSearchResultBuilder class, testing its functionality related to building and manipulating SearchResult objects.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResultBuilderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the ImmutableSearchResultBuilder's behavior and correctness.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the SearchResultBuilder instance before each test.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullSearchResult
methods.description: Tests that passing null to the 'of' method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: copySearchResultWithBuilder
methods.description: Tests copying an existing SearchResult into a builder and verifying equality.

methods.name: copyAndModifyExistingSearchResultWithBuilder
methods.description: Tests copying and modifying an existing SearchResult, such as setting the next page offset.

methods.name: createEmptySearchResult
methods.description: Verifies that building a SearchResult with no items results in an empty SearchResult with no next page.

methods.name: tryToAddNullItem
methods.description: Ensures that adding null as an item throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToRemoveNullItem
methods.description: Ensures that removing null as an item throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addThingItem
methods.description: Tests adding a JSON item representing a 'thing' to the SearchResult.

methods.name: addAndRemoveThingItem
methods.description: Tests adding and then removing a 'thing' JSON item, verifying the SearchResult is empty.

methods.name: setNextPageOffset
methods.description: Tests setting the next page offset in the SearchResult.

methods.name: tryToAddAllNull
methods.description: Verifies that adding null to the builder results in a NullPointerException.

methods.name: addItemsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding multiple items via 'addAll' and verifying the resulting SearchResult contains all items.
